highlight.en: Elite forehand unit turn. Serve consistency is tour-level.
highlight.zh: 正手转体堪称教科书，发球稳定性接近比赛水平。

highlight.en: Solid two-handed backhand. Footwork on approach shots needs work.
highlight.zh: 双手反手扎实，但上网步法还需打磨。

highlight.en: Aggressive baseline game. Volley technique is the next frontier.
highlight.zh: 底线攻击型打法，截击技术是下一个突破口。

highlight.en: Consistent rally pace. Add more spin to the serve toss.
highlight.zh: 回合球节奏稳定，发球抛球可再多加上旋。

highlight.en: Good rally sense. Shorten backswing on the backhand side.
highlight.zh: 比赛意识不错，反手引拍可以再短一些。

highlight.en: Enthusiastic movement. Focus on contact point consistency.
highlight.zh: 跑动积极，重点提升击球点的稳定性。
